name: Onga (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Onga town emblem in white: a stylised device of a cross with curved arms.
history: Municipal flag of Onga, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1972.

features.role: Onga town emblem — a stylised device of a cross with curved arms
